articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s quantum threat is becoming an economic problem
articles.description: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

articles.title: As it happened: Binance’s record $6.3B crypto hack

articles.title: Bitcoin risks worst October in 12 years as tech sell-off spreads to gold
articles.description: Bitcoin circled $77,000 as crypto markets navigated US stock-market downside, while the gold price fell to its lowest in a year.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Will gold’s ‘infinite mint bug’ make Bitcoin more valuable?
articles.description: A US fusion startup says it has turned mercury into gold. Could a potential increase in the gold supply strengthen Bitcoin’s claim to be a better form of digital gold?

articles.title: Binance working with FBI to recover assets following $6.3B hack
articles.description: Binance is working with law enforcement to recover $3 billion that is frozen, after setting aside more than $6.3 billion from the company’s funds to cover the shortfall.

articles.title: Binance says it holds $5B in matching tokens to cover hack losses
articles.description: The exchange said it set aside more than $6.34 billion to cover losses and would include the assets in its next proof-of-reserves report.

articles.title: Zcash grants group offers $124M compromise as governance backlash grows
articles.description: Zcash Community Grants proposed redirecting about $124 million in existing and future funding toward mining rewards, but critics say the plan fails to address governance and accountability concerns.

articles.title: Bitcoin price metrics hint at rebound as $1.6B liquidations follow Binance hack
articles.description: Bitcoin held above $76,000 after a $6.3 billion Binance hack and a tech-stock sell-off, as momentum indicators pointed to a possible rebound.

articles.title: EIP-7702 didn’t cause Binance hack, but may have amplified losses
articles.description: Security experts said attackers could have drained Binance’s wallets without EIP-7702, but the Ethereum upgrade may have helped bypass withdrawal safeguards.

articles.title: Binance hacker’s Bitcoin haul tops Coinbase’s corporate treasury
articles.description: The attackers held 18,270 BTC early Friday, topping Coinbase’s reported corporate holdings, and an Ether stash exceeding 500,000 ETH.

articles.title: THORChain’s RUNE jumps 13% after Binance’s record $6.3B hack

articles.title: Trezor warns CryptoBilis buyers to move funds over suspected implant
articles.description: Trezor urged customers who bought devices from CryptoBilis since March to move their funds after a report of a suspected hardware implant.

articles.title: Strategy eyes more Bitcoin buys as Saylor touts $30B credit capacity
articles.description: Michael Saylor says Strategy could create up to $30 billion in digital credit without new common-stock fundraising or further Bitcoin price gains, as the company plans more BTC purchases.

articles.title: North Korea’s TraderTraitor linked to $6.3B Binance hack
articles.description: TRM Labs said it has high confidence in the attribution, while ZachXBT identified stolen funds from the Binance and Bitget hacks converging at the same address.

articles.title: Binance hack could accelerate shift to DEXs: Standard Chartered
articles.description: Standard Chartered’s Geoffrey Kendrick said the breach could accelerate a shift toward decentralized trading and strengthen his case for Uniswap’s UNI token reaching $100 by 2030.

articles.title: Binance points to engineer’s hacked laptop in $6.3B breach

articles.title: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data

articles.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
articles.description: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.
